# ENet 1.3.18

Upstream: https://github.com/lsalzman/enet/tree/v1.3.18

Source archive: https://codeload.github.com/lsalzman/enet/zip/refs/tags/v1.3.18

Archive SHA-256: `32d6b15611c2667b88cd865e0cb48c3c011ddefcff6dfbdb266b8e0b04fffab3`

Retrieved 2026-09-24. MIT licence retained in `LICENSE`. The C sources, headers
and upstream CMakeLists.txt are unmodified. Documentation, examples and unrelated
build-system files were omitted. No downloaded executable is included or run.

The project's wrapper is in `src/platform/net`. ENet supplies reliable/unreliable
UDP delivery; it does not provide connection authentication, encryption, account
services, matchmaking or a hosted relay.
